brief: A rolling restart of a worker that declares nothing (brief-js161-restart.md): JS-161's worker measures its speed (bound 15 s; 6.1 to 7.6 s on a CI runner) before it registers, so a segment request waiting through a restart passes the 6 s queue timeout and is refused (test/roles.sh, queue run 45132952457). A worker that declares transcodeCores or transcodeSlots now registers at once and measures beside its work. Options: A keep, B count the reference speed until measured, C register at once for work already admitted only, D shorten the measurement, E hold JS-161.
tradeoff: Given up until JS-176 merges: on a cluster whose workers declare nothing and restart without a surge, with no other worker with room, a request in flight during the restart can be refused and a picture already playing freezes. The dogfood declares 3 and is unaffected.
entry: JS-161 merges with option A as a dated gap, not a rule: an undeclared worker registers only after measuring (bound 15 s), so on a cluster with no other worker with room a request in flight during a restart can be refused, and a picture already playing freezes. Given up until JS-176 merges, by viewers of clusters whose workers declare nothing and restart without a surge; the dogfood declares 3 and is unaffected. docs/status.md, docs/running.md and Changed guarantees say so, citing this. The guarantee is kept by option C as JS-176 at priority 20, which JS-166 depends on: a replacement registers at once for work already admitted and counts nothing for new plays until measured. Rejected: B (admits on a guess, the silent stall JS-161 removes), D (does not close the window and adds noise to a figure measured at 0.19 and 0.46 on one host), E (the dogfood's measured stall waits). Advising operators to declare capacity is a stopgap and leaves the docs with JS-176. Start-time measurement noise goes to the backlog (BL-252). Reopens on: JS-176's design review showing C needs more than one build (it returns as a brief), or a refused in-flight request on any deployment before it merges (JS-176 moves directly after JS-161). Superseded by D-062 (2026-11-23): the facts it rested on were corrected; its gap never ships.
serves: PRODUCT.md: 'Nothing breaks the viewers' evening. Upgrades, a lost machine and a database failover happen without interrupting anyone.' D-044: capacity is measured on the worker at start, not declared.
